about: Review 12, M2: work merged into the train while its wave was frozen by the WIP limit (W6.39, W10.G6), recorded instead of hidden. Append-only (scripts/plan/ledgerRatchet.mjs) and owned in CODEOWNERS; every mergeSha must be an ancestor of the train. plan:check counts these ids as started, the frozen-wave gate (scripts/plan/wipGate.mjs) accepts exactly them, and the board shows them as "merged, held by frozen wave". See scripts/plan/mergedWhileFrozen.mjs.
